description: This file defines the EmployeePictureService class in the OrangeHRM project, providing functionalities for managing employee pictures, including CRUD operations, size adjustments, ETag caching, and access control based on user roles.

classes.name: EmployeePictureService
classes.description: Service class for managing employee pictures, including retrieval, saving, size adjustment, caching, and access control logic.

methods.name: getEmployeePictureDao
methods.description: Lazy loads and returns the EmployeePictureDao instance used for database operations.

methods.name: pictureSizeAdjust
methods.description: Resizes the input picture to fit within 200x200 pixels while maintaining aspect ratio.

methods.name: saveEmployeePicture
methods.description: Saves the provided EmpPicture entity to the database.

methods.name: getEmpPictureByEmpNumber
methods.description: Retrieves an employee's picture by employee number.

methods.name: getAccessibleEmpPictureByEmpNumber
methods.description: Retrieves an employee's picture if the requester has access rights or is the employee themselves.

methods.name: getEmpPictureETagByEmpNumber
methods.description: Retrieves the ETag for an employee's picture, utilizing cache if possible.

methods.name: deleteEmpPictureETagByEmpNumber
methods.description: Deletes the ETag cache for a specific employee's picture.

methods.name: getEmpPictureETagAlongWithCache
methods.description: Generates and caches the ETag for an employee picture.

methods.name: generateEmpPictureETagCacheKey
methods.description: Creates a cache key string for storing the employee picture's ETag.
